name: heat_flow_chamber
label: Thermal gradient and interface chambers
description: Extracts chamber gradient, geometry, flow settings and accumulation results for each chamber experiment.
origin: thermal gradient and gas-water interface chambers
system_prompt: Extract values from a scientific paper. Report only what the paper states.
intro: Extracts chamber gradient, geometry, flow settings and accumulation results for each chamber experiment. For every set (and sample) in the structure plan below, extract the values the paper reports. A value that holds for every set goes in ONE row with `set` ''; one that differs between sets goes in each set's row; one that differs between the samples of a set goes in each sample's row.

parameters.description: Temperature of the heated side of the chamber.
Temperature of the cooled side of the chamber.
Temperature difference between the warm and cold sides of the chamber.
Thickness or gap height of the microfluidic chamber or fracture.
Liquid inflow rate into the chamber.
Gas flow rate across the gas-water interface.
Measured velocity of water flow or tracer beads in the chamber.
Local concentration at the interface, meniscus or chamber section relative to the bulk or initial concentration.
Thermophoretic Soret coefficient of a solute.
